[USER] Area No 1: Data DAOs  
[USER] The opportunity: DAOs are distributed entities with transparent governance and decision-making processes.  
[USER] Data DAOs focus on the preservation, curation, augmentation, and promotion of high-value datasets.  
[USER] Examples of Data DAOs include genomic databases, historical blockchain data, Wikipedia, NFT collections, and metaverse assets.  
[USER] Stake in Data DAOs can be tokenized, allowing for objective expression and transaction of data value.  
[USER] Interested parties can earn tokens by analyzing datasets and performing scientific and ML modeling.  
[USER] Stakeholders can spend tokens to incentivize production of raw data, creating a circular data-centric economy.  
[USER] The potential: FVM enables the implementation of Data DAOs with composable layers for various DAO types.
